meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入一个口令，瞬间唤醒智能体的全力模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要让智能体集中火力完成高难度任务。
copy.tagline_en: Enter a trigger phrase to switch the agent into deep-work mode.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often ask your agent to handle tough jobs and want a quick way to maximize its effort.

howto.what: 当你在输入中包含 "ultrawork" 或 "ulw" 时,Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式:第一句可见回复固定为 "ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!",随后按严格流程工作——先调查与规划,再写失败测试、实现代码,并用真实界面证据验证完成,全程用笔记记录进度。
howto.when: 触发条件是你的输入里出现 "ultrawork" 或 "ulw"。指令会以隐藏消息注入到你的文本之前,Claude 在本轮按该模式执行。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式,修复登录接口的 500 错误
say.note: 会先显示 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say.text: ultrawork: 给订单模块写测试,先红后绿
say.note: 按失败优先的证据流程执行

say.text: 用 ulw 重构这段代码,并在真实界面验证
say.note: 会经历调查、规划、验证全流程

howto.what_en: When your prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw', Claude enters ultrawork mode. Its first visible reply is 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then it plans, writes failing tests, implements, and verifies with real-surface evidence while keeping a notepad.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever the prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'. The directive is injected before your text and Claude follows the mode for that turn.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix the 500 error on the login endpoint.
say_en.note: The first reply will be ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: ultrawork: write tests for the order module, red first then green.
say_en.note: It follows the fail-first proof flow.

say_en.text: Use ulw to refactor this code and verify on the real UI.
say_en.note: It runs discovery, planning and verification.
